Superb visit
Nov 2025 • Couples

Quality of food is very good. Steak was made medium and the sides and sauce were perfect. Pizza was delicious. 

My special mention goes to the waitress lady who speaks perfect english, remembers the ordery and us even the next day and was very friendly, helpful and attendative. 
I really recommend that you visit this place as it is the best restaurant in the area.

Amazing food/ value for money
Oct 2025 • Family
Just enjoyed a great meal. Staff super attentive. Two of us shared a Vietnamese family meal banquet which could easily have fed 3-4 and amazing variety of flavours. The other 2 had fillet steaks which were cooked to perfection and as good as top steak restaurants in London. Wine list very comprehensive and overall very good value for money.
Only disappointment is that it was very quiet in the restaurant but we are out of season. A wedding party upstairs certainly sounded like they were having a great time so clearly liked by locals which is always a good sign. 
Will definitely try to get back before we leave Ha Long.
